about: Welcome to one of the most diverse and competitive but unifying sports in the world - street basketball.
3on3 FreeStyle features fast-paced real-time basketball match against live opponents. It is you with friends versus three of them!
You can play with your friends via online or at home. It is time for you to create your own style with turns you into a street basketball legend.
This product supports the following languages: English
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
